content: उद्युज् €7 <ab>U.</ab> (Usually <ab>Ā.</ab> only) .²1 To excite, make active or quick, stimulate to exertion. .²2 (<ab>intrans.</ab>) To exert, attempt, strive (with <ab>inf.</ab>); भवन्तमभियोक्तुमुद्युङ्क्ते <ls>Dk. 3</ls>. .²3 To prepare. .²4 To join, be in contact with; यथा हस्ती हस्तिन्याः पदेन पदमुद्युजे <ls>Av. 6. 70. 2</ls>.
